content:
The strips have areas proportional to differences of squared heights from the vertex.

The bottom strip, between heights \(\frac{9h}{10}\) and \(h\), has area
\[
A\left(1-\left(\frac{9}{10}\right)^2\right)
= A\left(1-\frac{81}{100}\right)
= \frac{19A}{100}.
\]
This is the largest part, so
\[
\frac{19A}{100}=38 \implies A=200.
\]

\boxed{200}
